items.title: Systemic drift and independent oversight: why complex systems may need continuous monitoring as they evolve
items.summary: NIST's 2026 report highlights the difficulty of monitoring deployed AI systems. Andy Hyman's MPOSD framework offers external, continuous monitoring that compares observed behavior with a system's defined purpose, like an EKG for complex systems.
items.titleZh: 系统漂移和独立监督：为什么复杂系统在发展过程中可能需要持续监控
items.summaryZh: NIST 2026年的报告强调了监控部署的人工智能系统的困难。Andy Hyman的MPOSD框架提供外部、持续的监控，将观察到的行为与系统定义的目的进行比较，就像复杂系统的心电图一样。
